name: suwu
description: Suwu — standalone Go server + Vite/React frontend for the xterm.js terminal emulator

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && go build -ldflags "-s -w -X suwu/pkg/version.Version=$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')" -o suwu ./cmd/Suwu
scripts.check:ext-dist: pnpm run build:ext && git diff --exit-code -- examples/extension/*/dist
